This provides geometrically expressive supervision and prevents the model from overfitting to appearance in sparse views, which would otherwise compromise geometry [S1].

The claim states that the method provides 'geometrically expressive supervision' and 'prevents the model from overfitting to appearance in sparse views, which would otherwise compromise geometry'.
